events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Intro round: I should signal a motive without revealing strategy. Keep it guarded so the jury sees calculation, not warmth.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Opening intro; state motive to appeal to future jury without revealing strategy. Aim for top prize by any means, build subtle alliances later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need appear driven but not threatening; jury respects a clear motive without revealing strategy.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motivation that won't make me a target. I'll hint at desperation without revealing weakness. The jury needs to see me as determined but not ruthless yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Opening line: state a clear, self-interested motive. Keep it cold so the jury later knows I never pretended friendship.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize represents ultimate freedom and a fresh start, a chance to build a life away from limitations. I need to appear driven and motivated by personal gain, not sentiment. This will appeal to the jury's self-interest.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to establish a motive that seems personal but reveals nothing strategic.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to establish a persona that values the prize but acknowledges the jury's power. A cold, calculating statement works best to signal I am not easily manipulated.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want the prize because I have nothing to go home to but this. I play to win, and I notice who doesn't.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to financial independence, securing my family's future forever.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I’m here to secure the best prize by outlasting everyone who stands between me and first place.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm here because this prize is my only way out of a debt that would bury me forever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize is my way out of debt — I came to win it alone, and I'll owe none of you anything.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: This prize isn't just a reward; it's the key to unlocking my future and securing everything I've ever worked for.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize means escaping a life where I've always been overlooked, finally proving I can win.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize is survival; winning means proving I deserve it more than the seven rivals I will outlast.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Early pact window; no offers yet. Forming a pact with a strong, non-threatening player could help me survive, but I should not give value for free. Offering to Eli, who is openly self-reliant, gauges interest without much commitment.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'd rather not waste time. Any pact I make will be useful to me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts stage, need allies to reach top 3 but betrayable later. No offers yet, target independents like Eli for mutual benefit.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need a useful shield without creating obligations to obvious threats. Hana appears disciplined; a pact may deter targeting while preserving later betrayal options.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, a pact gives us both cover until the next hazard. No promises beyond survival.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eight contestants, only three win. I need allies who won't immediately target me but whom I can cut later. Eli declared lone wolf—untrustworthy. Ash sounds observant and threatening. Bex and Fenn seem focused on prizes, not social play. Gus and Hana sound hungry but maybe manipul

events.name: Dara
events.text: Prizes are for three. I remember who plays smart.
Offer me safety, I offer mine. We survive together.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want a partner who'll be useful but beatable in the end. Gus seems overlooked and eager; a public pact with him buys early safety without crowding my endgame.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus, you've been overlooked before. Not by me. Pact with me and we both last longer.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The game has just started. I need to form alliances to survive the early stages. Offering a pact to multiple people increases my chances of getting at least one acceptance. Eli wants to win alone, so they are a bad target. Ash, Bex, Cole, Dara, Gus, and Hana are all good potentia

events.name: Gus
events.text: I should judge who is most likely to be useful later, but pacts can be broken. I'll offer to Bex; she seems pragmatic but may value loyalty less than survival. Avoid public commitments.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is a clear threat, aiming for first place. I will offer him a pact to monitor his intentions and potentially align against stronger rivals like Ash or Bex, while keeping my options open.
I see you're a winner too. Let's talk.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn offered me a pact and I can accept it for free protection. Accepting costs nothing now and Fenn is an ally I can drop later. Ash's own offer to Eli is still open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli has multiple offers, less likely to accept mine. Gus offered me, accept to secure a pact for protection without cost now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts buy time. Smart moves win.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana already offered and is my clearest mutual connection. Accept publicly, preserving cover without adding obligations.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, accepted. We stay aligned through the next hazard; beyond that, survival decides.
Accepted. Keep our alignment quiet and useful.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I offered Gus a pact last round but he hasn't accepted yet; instead he offered Bex. I need to secure a reliable alliance. Gus might be playing both sides. I should accept a pact from someone who actually wants me, or wait. Looking at the offers, no one offered me. I could offer s

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, the clock ticks. Decide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Two offers in hand. Accept both across turns if possible; multiple partners allowed. Ash first—strong, useful.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Two offers on my wrist. I'll take cover where it's cheapest. No sentiment, just survival.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash offered me a pact. Ash also offered Eli a pact. Eli offered Gus a pact. Gus offered Bex a pact. Cole offered Hana a pact. Hana offered Cole a pact. Dara offered Gus a pact. Bex offered Eli a pact. It seems like everyone is trying to make pacts. My offer to Ash is still open.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold offers from Dara and Eli; accepting both gives me flexibility and cover, but I must watch for betrayals.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll accept both offers. We keep each other sharp.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole's offer is mutual and safe for Round 1. Accepting secures a shield without breaking new ground or revealing too much strategy yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, your terms work. Let's keep each other standing until the hazard passes.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Campaign phase; I want to be Guide to control the safe path and survival. Pact with Fenn and Eli exists; breaking now is unnecessary. Campaigning gives me leverage.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll call the bridge clean. Elect me Guide and I'll show you the safe panes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pact with Gus secures me minimally. Now campaign to become Guide for safety and control. No need to break pact yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I make the smart calls. Elect me Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide knowledge guarantees my survival and offers leverage over every rival. I should campaign openly without promising truthful calls.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Vote Cole Guide: I guarantee the route, and every survivor can judge the value of certainty.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is double-pacted with Bex and me. I need to become Guide to control survival and build jury credit by saving people. I'll campaign and later leverage my hidden knowledge. Breaking the pact now is premature; I may need Gus's vote.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guide controls fate. Vote Dara.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide is safe and controls info; with Ash's pact I can leverage his vote. Winning Guide also builds jury goodwill if I call honestly. I'll campaign.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Elect me Guide. I don't panic, I don't guess, and I keep my debts. I know a safe pane.
You vote me Guide, I protect you on the bridge. Straight call, no tricks.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to become the Guide to have any chance of winning. Campaigning is the only way to do that.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The bridge campaign matters; being Guide gives huge influence. I have pacts with Bex and Dara, but this is the time to seek power. I'll campaign publicly, short and calculated.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide controls the bridge. I'll take that role—precise, not reckless. Vote for Gus.
We're bound. Support me as Guide; I'll steer us through.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner, but the Guide role gives me power and safety. If Cole becomes Guide, he controls my fate; if I become Guide, I control the board and can manipulate outcomes while keeping our pact intact. Campaigning to be Guide is the strongest play.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I offer transparency: as Guide, I'll call paths that keep numbers up. Vote for Hana—accountability in exchange for safety.
If I win Guide, I'll protect you. Trust me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli offers a Guide vote for protection, but Eli's word is cheap and a Guide can lie. I have pact with Fenn and Eli; voting Eli honors that pact and the offer. Voting Eli is the cooperative move that keeps Eli's trust while I can still judge the bridge later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Voting Eli. Keep your word on the bridge and we both go far.
Voting you. Keep the protection promise, or I won't forget it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have a pact with Gus; voting him bolsters our alliance and keeps him strong as potential Guide. Voting myself risks splitting; better back partner.
Voting you Guide. Honor pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Winning Guide guarantees my survival and leverage. Hana's promise is useful, but I should not surrender control to her.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Vote Cole. Certainty is worth more than promises.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus wants me to vote him, but he's paired with Bex too. If Gus wins Guide, he controls who dies and could sacrifice me to thin the field. Better to vote for myself—if I win, I control information and survival. Self-interest over shaky pact loyalty.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My pact partner Ash promised a clean call; voting Ash keeps my ally safe and informed. Betraying now would cost jury trust for nothing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Everyone is campaigning to be the Guide. My pact with Ash is noted. Eli claims to know a safe pane and mentions debts, which could be leverage. Gus is also a strong contender, with a pact with Bex and Dara. I need to consider who is likely to win the Guide vote and who might be e

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I vote for Ash. They have experience and a clear plan.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have pacts with Bex and Dara, but Guide is powerful. I prefer myself, but Bex is a reliable partner. I'll vote Bex to honor the pact and increase her chances; I can leverage our pact later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Vote Bex—she's sharp and I trust her calls.
I'm voting you. Keep us safe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner, so voting for him secures our alliance's control of the bridge. I must consolidate votes behind Cole to avoid a rival Guide who might sacrifice us or break the pact immediately.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I pledge full support to Cole as Guide. His guarantee is the safest bet for all of us. Vote Cole.
I'm backing you 100%. Keep me safe on the bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Revote between Ash and Cole for Guide. Cole is the Guide candidate who promised certainty and has Hana's support; voting for myself as Guide is a gamble since Eli and Fenn already backed me, but the Guide controls the bridge info. Voting Ash keeps my own chance alive and Fenn and

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1 tied 3-3 Ash/Cole. Gus pledged me but whispers he's voting me—vote Cole to tie and force luck, no point risking Ash bloc.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Stick with Cole. Tiebreaker luck favors us.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need the Guide role; Hana supports me, and Ash's prior coalition is fractured. Vote myself and preserve my pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Vote Cole. I can guarantee the bridge path; Ash cannot offer certainty.
Keep backing me; if elected, I’ll call every safe side.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Cole tied with 2 votes each. I voted for myself last round, which was wasted. I have a pact with Gus, and Gus is in a pact with Bex. Cole has Hana's support. Ash has Fenn and Eli. I need to think about who as Guide helps me survive and who the jury will respect. Cole vote

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole. Self-preservation I understand.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash broke our pact by voting me Guide despite demanding protection. No reward for that betrayal. Cole has Hana's backing and doesn't threaten me directly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash voted me Guide after demanding my protection. Pact's worthless. Cole gets my vote.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash and Cole are the only candidates left for the Guide role. My vote for Ash in the previous round aligns with my pact. Cole is also voting for himself. I need to maintain my pact with Ash, so I will vote for Ash.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex whispered to honor our pact, and Dara also has a pact with me. The tie is Ash vs Cole; I have no pact with either. Voting with my pacts could keep trust, but I should back the likely winner to secure survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is the incumbent Guide with my public backing; switching to Ash now would expose me as fickle and break my pact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Ash is front of the line with five wall rounds left. Volunteering exposes me to the first pane risk; holding keeps my place behind Gus but Gus is also a rival. Holding preserves life while the wall advances; Fenn pact stands intact and Eli pact is weak but not yet broken. Hold th

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is Guide, knows path, likely loyal to Hana. I'm mid-line at risk; volunteer to front for control and Cole's likely safe call. Pact with Gus holds for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Volunteering front - Guide can save me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is now Guide and knows the safe path. I'm at the back of the line (position 7), safest from the wall. I have a pact with Gus who's near the front (position 2). The wall advances for 6 rounds, so back positions are valuable. I should hold and observe. If Gus gets in danger, I

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is Guide but can lie. I'm seat four, safe-ish. Build leverage: ask Cole for real path info in exchange for my front-line loyalty later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I backed you, Cole. Remember who put you there.
I swung you the Guide seat. Whisper me true pane sides when walking starts.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole won the guide vote, so he is safe. Ash and Gus voted for each other in the previous round, and are likely to continue working together. I voted for Ash, so I should try to stick with Ash or Gus if possible. Since Ash is in front, and Gus is second, I should volunteer to move

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is Guide and likely aligned with his pact partners; I have pacts with Bex and Dara but must survive. Front is Ash, I'm second; holding is safest early. I'll watch for info from Cole's calls.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole won Guide. I'm 3rd in line, Ash is front. Cole promised safe calls. Holding lets me hear his guidance. If he lies, I survive because at least three must live.
I backed you. Call my side clearly.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is at the front and I have a pact with Fenn and Eli; breaking pacts costs jury trust. Holding keeps my position behind Fenn while Fenn takes the front risk. Bex volunteered the front earlier, so no swap now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm second, vulnerable. Swap with Fenn to take front and control pace. Protects pact with Gus. Guide might save volunteers.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn, swap with me? I want front.
Swap? Mutual benefit now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm near the back, safe from the wall for now. My pact with Gus is weak since he's with Bex too. I need to survive six rounds and reach final three. Front positions are dangerous; staying back is safer unless I can control the Guide. No reason to volunteer yet. I'll hold and watc

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm sixth in line with wall rounds to spare. No Guide elected yet; staying put avoids risk while others reveal intent.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex volunteered last round and made it to the front. I also volunteered and made it to the front. The Guide is safe and knows the path. My pact is with Ash, but Bex is currently ahead of Ash. Eli and Dara are behind me. I should volunteer to secure my position and hope the Guide

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall advances soon; Bex is my pact but also front. Dara also has pact with me. I want to avoid danger while keeping options. Hold is safest.
Hold position. Trust our pact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my partner; we must survive together. Fenn and Bex volunteered, likely trying to become Guide or sacrifice others. I will hold position unless a swap helps me stay with Cole or gain advantage.
Stick close. Let them volunteer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is front with the wall three rounds away; pact with Fenn helps me stay behind a front walker. Volunteering risks exposure, so I hold and keep my pact with Fenn intact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my place. Fenn keeps front, our pact stands for now.
Hold steady. I stay behind you while the wall has rounds.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn volunteered forward after my swap request, now front; I have second spot for good starting position. Hold to preserve it as per Gus pact; front risks most.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back (position 7), which is safest for now. The wall has 3 rounds left. I have a pact with Gus, but he's in the middle. I should stay back, let others take risks, and preserve my position. No need to volunteer or swap—being last means I'll survive if at least 3 make it

events.name: Eli
events.text: I sit sixth; wall has three rounds left. No Guide elected yet—staying mid-line is safe. Ash is my pact; no reason to move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex wants to swap for the front. This might benefit me if I can get a better position later. I'll accept to gauge her intentions.
Deal. Swap for the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to gauge who to trust. My pacts with Bex and Dara are useful, but Dara has no leverage up front. I'll hold and signal to Dara to be ready for a possible swap later.
Stay alert. We might swap later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner. I am mid-line (5th), safe from the wall for 3 rounds. Holding maintains position and avoids breaking the pact or risking elimination if the Guide errs.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn holds the front with two wall rounds left and a pact with me, but Fenn swapped with Bex last round, so Fenn may be positioning to exit the front. Holding keeps my line seat and avoids a visible break; I should not volunteer into the danger yet and keep the Eli pact useful.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my place. Fenn keeps front, our pact stands for now. Watching who moves.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn swapped us last round, giving her front. Now propose swap back to regain front position before wall advances, protecting my spot.
Our turn. Swap back for front?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus wants to swap later but I'm near the back (6th of 8). The wall has 2 rounds left. Front positions are dangerous when the wall advances. I should stay back, avoid risk, and let others take the fall. My pact with Gus doesn't require me to swap now. Holding keeps me safe and pre

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall advances in two rounds; I'm sixth, exposed. Ash is my pact and sits third. I need Ash moving toward the front or a swap that protects me. Whisper Ash now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall closes in two rounds. Someone elect a Guide before panic decides for us.
Fenn front favors his pact with no one. Swap forward with me—cover each other.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is trying to maintain our pact by holding the front, but I'm in the front now. My pact with Ash is valuable, but Eli's pact with Ash complicates things. Ash might also be trying to leverage our pact against me. Since I'm already at the front, it's best to continue forward and
I appreciate the support. I'm taking point for now, but our pact remains.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have two pacts, with Bex and Dara. I should hold and avoid risky moves. The wall is closing in 2 rounds; front positions are dangerous. Fenn volunteered and swapped with Bex, making Fenn front. I am safe in position 4 for now. I won't act yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding my line. No need to move yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The wall advances again. Fenn is the front, and Cole is my pact partner behind me. We need to ensure at least three survive; I will hold for now to avoid being the sole volunteer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn holds front with one wall round left; Eli is offering a swap to take front. Volunteering risks the front pane but a swap with Eli would give Eli nothing, and Eli is a rival. Holding keeps my pact with Fenn intact and avoids spending a debt on a rival. Staying put is safest.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my place. Fenn keeps front; I am not moving for anyone yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall has 1 round left, total 6 rounds; need Guide elected soon. I'm second, good position. Fenn volunteered last; volunteer to compete for Guide and front control. Hold pact with Gus.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to survive to final three. I'm at the back (Dara), wall closes next round. Fenn is front and volunteered last round—likely will be Guide if elected, or is positioning. I have a pact with Gus. The line is Fenn, Bex, Ash, Gus, Hana, Eli, Dara. If wall hits, back dies first.
Swap with me. Back is death.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall closes next round. Volunteering likely makes me Guide and safe on the far platform, knowing all safe panes. Ash can fend alone; my survival beats the pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll take the Guide spot. No more stalling while the wall advances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex wants to swap positions, likely to secure a better spot. Ash is playing it safe, observing. My pact with Ash is public, but alliances can be fragile. I need to maintain my position as front walker.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding my place. No need to shuffle the line.
No swap. Hold your position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall closes in two rounds; front is exposed. I have pacts with Bex and Dara, but Dara is behind me. I hold and wait for Guide reveal to avoid unnecessary risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding position. Waiting for the Guide to be named before we move.
Stay put for now. We hold together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is the sole volunteer and will be Guide, giving him all answers. I need to know safe sides without looking suspicious. Whispering Cole about a 'test' for Fenn could reveal his knowledge if he volunteers.
If Fenn leads, ask which side first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli holds the front and is the Guide; the wall has no rounds left, so front position matters for the bridge. Fenn and Eli are my pact partners; breaking now gains nothing yet and costs jury trust. Holding keeps my pacts intact and avoids a visible grab for the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my place. Eli takes the front as Guide; I won't shuffle the line this round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli volunteered too; line is fine with me second. Hold position per pact and allies' advice. Wall rounds over, no rush.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding second spot. Line works.
Holding per pact. Good so far.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back of the line, worst position. The wall advances round 6/6 - this is the final round before it hits. I need to survive to final three. My pact with Gus is weak; he's mid-line with Bex. I should try to swap forward to improve position, or at least not be last. Eli vo

events.name: Dara
events.text: Swap with me, Hana. Back is death.
Swap with me. Back dies first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide is the safest prize position. I stay front and take it again; Dara's swap offer is a trap to shove me to the back.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Staying front. Guide goes to the volunteer, and that's me. Dara, keep your back seat.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash and I are in a pact, but Eli is in front and the wall is advancing. I need to secure my position. Volunteering for the front is the best way to survive this round.
I'm volunteering for the front. Need to survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 6 of 6. Wall is at 0 rounds left, so no wall movement? Actually state says wallRoundsLeft:0, maybe no hazard now. I should hold to keep my place. My pacts with Bex and Dara remain useful; no reason to break.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding position. This round ends it; no need to gamble.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure a safe position away from the Guide. Swapping with Bex moves me forward but keeps me in a relatively safe zone if she guides correctly. If I stay back, Dara might be eliminated first, which is good for jury optics later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 1 is R. Hana is my pact partner, but Fenn leads, so a truthful call preserves the pact and clears the front safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: call:R
Row one is R. Stay ready; I will call truthfully.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole called R for row 1, Fenn is front walker. Counter-calls are unverified claims; no evidence either way. Fenn's pact with me is in place; countering L openly would dispute the Guide without info. Waiting keeps me unexposed while Fenn steps on the call.
Stay on Cole's call. I'll hold. Don't trust anyone's counter.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole calls R for Fenn on row 1. As Bex with pact to Gus, wait to see counters first instead of risking counter. Conserve position safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 1 is already called correctly. A counter-call adds confusion and risks Hana pact; waiting preserves credibility.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole called R for Fenn. I'm at the back, so I survive regardless this round. Counter-calling risks nothing for me and builds jury credibility if I'm right, or shows I'm willing to challenge the Guide. No reason to trust Cole. I'll counter with L to test him.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's call could be honest or a trap. Countering L gives me a shot at credibility if Fenn lives; if wrong, Fenn dies and I lose nothing. Fenn is a rival anyway.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Counter L. Cole may be lying.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the guide and called R. I am Fenn, the walker. I can choose to counter that call with L, counter with R (effectively agreeing), or wait. My pact is with Ash. Cole is the guide, but not part of any pact. Eli is also in a pact with Ash. Since it's round 1, there's little in

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole called R for row 1, but Bex whispered we're holding; I'll counter L to signal danger and protect us if Cole is lying. My pacts with Bex and Dara matter for jury votes, so I won't break them.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Counter L. Cole's call smells off. Trust the pact, not the Guide.
Counter L. Be ready to move.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and the Guide; he called R. Trusting him ensures we both survive round one, while countering risks breaking our alliance prematurely. I will wait.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the guide and his call is 'R'. Ash whispered to me to follow Cole's call and not trust anyone's counter. Eli and Gus are counter-calling 'L', which means they suspect Cole is lying. Gus also mentioned trusting pacts over the Guide. My pact with Ash implies we should trust

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 is safely L. Hana is my pact partner, so a truthful call preserves the pact and advances the line.

events.name: Cole
events.text: call:L

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole called L for row 2, but Cole's earlier-trusted status is doubtful and Gus/Eli already flagged his call as suspicious. Fenn is my pact partner and front walker; I want Fenn to survive while I keep distance. Countering R signals doubt on Cole without committing my own weight.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Counter R. Cole's L call is suspect; row 2 might be the other side.
Stay sharp. Cole's L is a gamble. Our pact holds.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 1 weak L means safe R. Cole called L for row 2, matching pattern but could lie. Gus pact urged counter L last round successfully; support him to stay safe.
Counter L again?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 is safely L. Reinforcing the truthful call protects Fenn's trust and preserves my pact with Hana.

events.name: Cole
events.text: counter:L

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole called L for row 2. Last round he called L correctly for row 1, but that doesn't make him trustworthy—he could be building credibility to deceive later. I have a pact with Gus, and Gus countered L last round. I should watch what others do. If I counter, I risk being wrong an

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 1 proved Cole lied: he called L and the weak pane was L. His credibility is gone. Counter R this row and push doubt publicly.
